clue.text: Cured meat at the end of second game

parts.note: to second a proposal is to back it
gammon is cured ham

explanation.surface: A shopper wants the cured ham at the far end of the second counter.
explanation.definitionFit: Backgammon is a board game for two players, moving counters by dice throws.

clue.text: Gannet naturally raised is partly aerial

indicators.note: raised says the hidden letters are read backwards
partly says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A seabird lifts itself into the sky, becoming partly airborne.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'raised' means read upwards, so the hidden ANNETNA is turned round.
explanation.definitionFit: An aerial is the rod or wire that picks up radio signals, the same device as an antenna.

clue.text: Majority cycling around a capital in Asia

indicators.note: the cycled word goes around the letter A

parts.note: the bulk of something is most of it

explanation.surface: Most of a group are cycling round an Asian capital city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cycling' moves the K of BULK to the front, giving KBUL, which goes 'around' A.
explanation.definitionFit: Kabul is the capital city of Afghanistan.

clue.text: Misfortune of child seen regularly in play

indicators.note: the picked letters go inside the word for play

indicators.note: regularly takes every other letter of the two words, starting from the first

parts.note: its first, third, fifth, seventh and ninth letters are taken

explanation.surface: A mishap befell a child who was regularly seen playing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' runs across both words, 'child' and 'seen', not just the first, so the picked letters cross the word break.
explanation.definitionFit: An accident is an unlucky mishap, a piece of bad fortune.

clue.text: New slide made GP study distribution in later life

indicators.note: new means these letters are made into a fresh arrangement

parts.note: a general practitioner, the family doctor
to study a subject at university is to read it

explanation.surface: A family doctor studies a new slide showing how something is spread among older people.
explanation.walkthrough: At British universities you 'read' a subject, meaning study it; 'distribution' is spread in the sense of how weight is laid out.
explanation.definitionFit: Middle-age spread is weight gained around the waist in midlife, a spreading of fat around the body.

clue.text: Replacement vessel gets you to US airport

explanation.definitionFit: Monster used as an adjective means enormous, as in a monster hit.

clue.text: Hot place on Earth supported flowering plant

parts.note: hell is traditionally fiery
to bear a weight; the past tense bore

explanation.surface: A plant flourishing somewhere hot on our planet.
explanation.definitionFit: Hellebores are winter-blooming perennials such as the Christmas rose.

clue.text: 12 dozen gutted library in a horrid way

indicators.note: a gutted word has its insides removed, leaving only the ends

parts.note: its first and last letters are kept

explanation.surface: A library stripped of a hundred and forty-four books, done shockingly.
explanation.definitionFit: Grossly means disgustingly or in an offensive manner.

clue.text: Attempt to bring mammals back

parts.note: bats are flying mammals

explanation.surface: A conservation effort to bring mammals back.
explanation.definitionFit: Having a stab at something is having a go or a try.

clue.text: Rubbish fish mostly gulp near edge of pond

clue.text: Relative leaving the French boy without clothes

clue.text: Letter of substance reported generosity of spirit

clue.text: Island cheers beginning of sailing craze

indicators.note: the opening letter of sailing

parts.note: a mania is a craze

explanation.surface: An island toasts the start of a sailing fad.
explanation.definitionFit: Tasmania is the large island state south of mainland Australia.

clue.text: Wrongly inform of fog finally clearing on harbour

indicators.note: the final letter of the word clears away

parts.note: mist is a light fog
re means on or concerning
a port is a harbour

explanation.surface: Mistaken news of fog lifting over a harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: To misreport is to give a false or inaccurate account.

clue.text: Steer to encircle extremely raggedy creature

parts.note: a steer is a castrated bull, an ox

indicators.note: extremely means the two extreme letters of raggedy

explanation.definitionFit: The oryx is a large straight-horned African antelope.

clue.text: Wine area lit up after five

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral five

indicators.note: up as in mixed up or in turmoil, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.definitionFit: A varietal is a wine made from and named after a single grape variety.

clue.text: God recalling the folly of Eden

parts.note: Prime Minister Anthony Eden's disastrous 1956 Suez intervention

explanation.surface: A deity recalls the foolishness in the Garden of Eden.
explanation.walkthrough: Eden here is Anthony Eden, British Prime Minister brought down by the Suez Crisis of 1956, not the biblical garden.
explanation.definitionFit: Zeus is king of the Olympian deities in Greek myth.

clue.text: Film Dynasty over on large compound

the Han dynasty of China
O is the cricket scorebook abbreviation for an over
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large

explanation.definitionFit: Ethanol is the chemical compound that is drinking alcohol.

clue.text: Cocks perhaps on English church disappear

parts.note: weathercocks are weather vanes
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Cockerels on an English church vanish.

explanation.definitionFit: To evanesce is to fade away and vanish like vapour.

clue.text: Animal shelter stuck with label 'house'

clue.text: Part of speech raved about Britain

explanation.definitionFit: An adverb is a word class modifying verbs, such as quickly.

second meaning: said aloud, you is ewe, so this is what does a female sheep good

explanation.walkthrough: 'orally' says to hear 'you' as EWE, a female sheep, and the dip is what benefits her.

clue.text: Note taken from very friendly prisoner

clue.text: Part of America periodically using just cash

clue.text: Self-absorbed clot hesitantly gathers linen

parts.note: the answer runs across the end of the first word, all of the second and the start of the third
